question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution:
The correct answer is** "adequate"**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given options, **"adequate**' is the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.
 
• In the given sentence, **'awareness'** is an uncountable abstract noun.
 
• **Abstract nouns **are those nouns that can not be seen, touched, or heard. 
 
 
• **Examples**: All the feelings or intangible ideas like Loyalty, Love, kindness etc.
 
 
 
• We use the word **"adequate" **to mean** **sufficient for a specific need or requirement.
 
 
• **Example:** Children who are growing should receive an **adequate **amount of nourishment from the school lunch.
 
 
 
• Thus, ***option 4) ***is the correct alternative.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**Let us see the usage of other quantifiers in the option.

 
• **Quite:** When we use quite + a/an + adjective + noun it means the same as 'a little or a lot but not completely:

 
 
• **Example:** It's quite a big company.
 
 
 
• **Much: **It is used with singular, uncountable nouns.
 
 
• **Example:** Happiness, music, water, time etc. 
 
 
 
• **A Few:** We use a few if the noun is countable.
 
 
• **Example: ** jars of jam, students.
